wn-h1.title: What's new
wn-h1.body: Every release we ship that your plan opens, newest first. A release you have not seen yet carries a New tag; opening this page marks it seen.

wn-rel-h.title: Every release
wn-rel-h.body: Each release says what it does, where to try it and, when it has one, a prompt for your AI. A new one also shows once as a card the first time you open the terminal after it goes live.

wn-ai-h.title: Ask your AI what's new
wn-ai-h.body: Your connected AI can call whats_new for the releases since it last asked, or since a date, and mention the ones that bear on what you are doing.
